name: Miss Doyle
text: Limit 1 per deck. Forced - After Miss Doyle enters play: Search your bonded cards for Hope, Zeal, and Augur. Randomly choose 1 to put into play and shuffle the other 2 into your deck. When Miss Doyle leaves play, find each of those assets (even if they are out of play) and set them aside, out of play.
text_cn: 每副牌组限制1张。 强制 - 在道尔女士入场后：在你的绑定卡牌中查找希望、热诚和预见。随机选择1张放置入场，并将其余2张混洗入你的牌堆。在道尔女士离场时，找出这几张支援卡(不论其是否在场)，并将其放在一边，位于场外。(FAQ, v2.0)
